Camera and WebGL renderer modules from https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad,
packages/core/src/common, retrieved 2026-10-06 (MIT, see LICENSE).
Modules remain unmodified. Roomwise calls this runtime for its CAD camera/viewer.
The CAD Python source export uses cadgen==0.7.15 and its documented build123d
model/export contract. Roomwise's parameter model, editing, persistence and
room solids are application code, not the upstream desktop/MCP app.
